items.title: Complete Coordination Before the Pooja

items.title: Samagri Guidance or Arrangement Support

faqs.question: Can I book a purohit for pooja at home?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can book a verified purohit for home pooja based on your city, pooja type, date, language preference, and availability.

faqs.question: Can I choose the pooja type?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can select the required pooja type such as Griha Pravesh, Satyanarayana Pooja, Vastu Shanti, Homam, Rudrabhishek, Lakshmi Pooja, and more.

faqs.question: Can I get a purohit in my preferred language?
faqs.answer: Yes, preferred language purohits can be arranged depending on your location and availability.

faqs.question: Will you help with samagri?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can share the samagri list in advance or help with samagri arrangement based on your requirement.

faqs.question: Can I get package details before booking?
faqs.answer: Yes, package details will be discussed before confirmation so you have clarity before proceeding.

faqs.question: Can I book a purohit urgently?
faqs.answer: Urgent purohit booking can be checked based on availability in your city.
